subject: Seatgear: remit and cross-entity payment handoff for Q4 invoice
messages:

Cc: Maya Torres <maya.torres@seatgear.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:15:00Z
Subject: Q4 invoice - need split by entity & cost centers

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Attached is our Q4 purchase — Seatgear is buying Redwood Hosted + Dedicated capacity across two legal entities (Seatgear US and Seatgear EU). Our AP team needs separate invoices and explicit cost-center lines so we can route each payment to the correct ledger.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Issue two invoices (US entity / EU entity) from different Redwood billing entities, with the same PO reference
- Include a cost-center breakdown on each invoice (Product / Support / Dedicated capacity)
- Provide clear remittance instructions per entity (bank details or payment portal link)

I attached the master invoice draft and a quick remit matrix. Procurement prefers payment within 30 days after we receive split invoices.

If you need anything from our side (tax IDs, supplier forms), let me know. We need to get this moving to avoid a procurement hold.

Thanks,
Alex Romero
Head of Procurement, Seatgear Inc.

Ben / Priyom — looping you both in. Seatgear needs two legal invoices but wants the PO/contract cross-referenced and a per-cost-center line item.

Ben: can billing create two invoices (Redwood Inc. US / Redwood Ltd. EU) from the same order and add cost-center lines? They need remit instructions per entity (bank details and payment portal link preferred).

Priyom: any VAT implications here? Seatgear is a platform customer with seats billed as SaaS; if we issue two invoices split by entity, do we need to apply reverse charge on the EU invoice or include VAT? Seatgear can provide tax IDs if needed.

Timeline: Procurement wants split invoices by EOD Wednesday (11/24) so they can route payments. Ben, is that feasible?

Hannah

Redwood Inference

Hannah / Priyom / Alex — thanks for the details. I reviewed the master invoice. Proposed approach:

1) Produce two invoice PDFs with matching invoice numbers connected via a parent reference (e.g., INV-20261101-PA/INV-20261101-PT).
2) Each invoice will include line-level cost-center tags: Product (SKU: HST-01), Support (SKU: SUP-01), Dedicated Capacity (SKU: DED-01).
3) Add our legal entity and bank remittance info on the corresponding invoice. For expedited payment, we'll include payment portal links and wires where possible.

Expected ETA: Draft split invoices delivered by 2026-11-24 14:00 UTC. I attached a remit matrix (separate file) with provisional routing.

Action items for Alex: please confirm the two legal entity billing names and the tax IDs you will provide for each entity. Also confirm which cost-center codes Seatgear will use on their side so the AP team can auto-match.

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Romero <alex@seatgear.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 invoice - VAT & cross-border considerations

Ben / Hannah / Alex — quick VAT note from legal/tax:

- If Seatgear EU will be billed by Redwood Ltd. (our EU entity), we should not apply UK/EU VAT when the customer provides a valid VAT ID and the supplies are B2B electronically supplied services — reverse charge may apply depending on the jurisdiction.
- For the US entity, no VAT; sales tax may be relevant depending on nexus — Seatgear has indicated no taxable nexus in our states.
- To keep AP happy, we'll put explicit "Tax treatment: Reverse Charge / VAT ID: <provided>" lines on the EU invoice.

Recommended invoice fields to avoid payment delays:
- Supplier legal name + registered address + tax ID
- Customer legal name + billing address + customer tax ID
- Line-level cost-center code (simple short code they can echo back)
- Parent invoice reference and cross-links to the other invoice PDF

I'll sign off on the EU tax wording as soon as Alex sends VAT IDs. If they can't produce a valid EU VAT ID we will need to charge VAT per local rules.

Priyom Das
Senior Tax & Compliance, Redwood Inference
